What we take care of

Insects and other common household pests can be a problem all year-round. We stop them before they contaminate food, take over living spaces, or put your family's health at risk.

Residential Pest Control

Ants, spiders, and household insects kept out of your home — with treatments timed to Utah's seasons.

Commercial Pest Control

We work with companies of any size to eliminate pests, so you can get back to what you do best.

Rodent Control

Mice and rats removed and shut out — sealing the entry points they use to get inside.

Cockroach Control

Targeted treatments that break the breeding cycle instead of just scattering them.

Spider Control

Webs swept, harborages treated, and barriers set so spiders stay outside where they belong.
